links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified LLM-generated patient education materials (before revision)
links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials; accuracy preserved
links.effect: Reading levels reduced by 4.8 (ChatGPT), 6.9 (Gemini), and 3.8 (Copilot) grade levels (P < .001) without compromising accuracy
links.quote: When instructed to revise educational materials to improve understandability, all large language models significantly reduced reading levels by 4.8 (ChatGPT), 6.9 (Gemini), and 3.8 (Copilot) grade levels (P < .001) without compromising accuracy.

design_hint: reading-level constraint via prompting for patient education materials
